## Entry Line

A journal line: `account` (an account code), `debitMinor` and `creditMinor` (integer cents, one of them zero), and the tags `cls`, `loc`, `party` and `doc`.

```ts
import { EntryLine } from '@cardstack/catalog/cards/accounting/ledger-cash';
```

Journal Entry, Scheduled Entry and Depreciation Run hold `lines = containsMany(EntryLine)` and post them as they are. Their `post` operations assert at least two lines, each line a debit or a credit but not both, every amount positive and in whole cents, every line with an account, and debits equal to credits.

### Non-goals
Carries no date of its own; the document's date applies. Amounts are integer cents (`…Minor` fields) with no currency field; the ledger is single-currency. The account is a text code, not a link.

### Example
The debit to Prepaid Insurance `1300` on an annual insurance payment.
